name: @clubhouse/features
description: Gherkin feature files and Cucumber-js step definitions for the ClubHouse acceptance tests

scripts.test: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --schema=../backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js --import "support/**/*.ts" --import "step_definitions/**/*.ts" --format ./formatters/scenario-list.ts --format html:../reports/cucumber.html "**/*.feature"
